meta.title: Qwen3.8-27B on DGX Spark
meta.subtitle: SGLang + NVFP4 + DFlash2 speculative decoding — a measured recipe for the GB10.
meta.hardware: One NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10): 128 GB unified memory, aarch64, Ubuntu 24.04, driver 580.173.02 / CUDA 13.0, Docker 29.2.1.
meta.reproduced: Reproduced on a second GB10 — boot-to-boot variance is ~8% on single-stream, so read small deltas as noise.

notes: 262144 context is the model default, so no --context-len flag is needed.
CPU pinned to 5-9,15-19 (the Cortex-X5 cores); first boot ≈ 3 min, weights ~25 GB download into the host HF cache on first run.
All model repos are public — no HF token required.

tier.label: Workload
tier.intro: Concurrency on this hybrid Gated-DeltaNet model is bought with mamba state slots, not KV cache. Each request needs 5 slots; SGLang clamps max_running_requests = pool / 5. Three flags move together — this card sets all of them.

interactive.label: Interactive
interactive.hint: One user, best single-stream decode. Pool 20 / cap 4 / graph 4.

high-throughput.label: High throughput
high-throughput.hint: Concurrent serving; peak aggregate 480.7 tok/s at 16 streams. Pool 80 / cap 16 / graph 16. Costs ~5% single-stream and 11.8 GB of GDN state.

spec.label: DFlash2 speculative decoding
spec.intro: A 27B draft model proposes tokens that the target verifies. It is the largest single-stream lever measured on this box (+28% at draft=16). Off means plain target-only decoding.

on.label: On
on.hint: DFLASH + pinned draft model. Measured everywhere in this recipe.

off.label: Off
off.hint: Not measured in this recipe — expect roughly target-only decode speed.

draft.label: Draft tokens
draft.intro: --speculative-num-draft-tokens. The optima diverge: 16 is best single-stream, 10 best for concurrent serving. Past 16, accept_len falls — the drafter can no longer sustain long correct runs, so extra draft compute buys rejected tokens.

ssm.label: SSM state dtype
ssm.intro: --mamba-ssm-dtype. bfloat16 halves the GDN state pool. Left unset, SGLang resolves to float32 and the pool doubles — on a 128 GB unified box that is 15.6 → 30.9 GB at pool 80, leaving ~12 GB free.

bfloat16.label: bfloat16 · default
bfloat16.hint: 3.8 GB pool at 20 slots, 15.6 GB at 80. The measured setting.

float32.label: float32
float32.hint: 7.6 GB at 20 slots, 30.9 GB at 80. Not measured as a serving config.

mem.label: Mem fraction
mem.intro: --mem-fraction-static. Not a performance lever here: 0.82 / 0.85 / 0.90 all measure within run-to-run noise, and the 1M token cap stays in every case. 0.85 is the settled default — baseline throughput with the most headroom.

0.90.hint: single 62.3 · 16-stream 468.7 · 25.3 GB free — use only after a known-good boot

path.label: Serving path
path.intro: Standalone gives one self-contained docker command. SparkStation adds the supervisor, the LiteLLM gateway on :8000, and automatic model lifecycle — at the cost of editing models.yaml.

standalone.label: Standalone docker
standalone.hint: One docker run, server on :8888, no orchestration.

interactive|on|16|bfloat16|0.85.note: Fresh-boot re-measurement; two of three runs cluster at 84–86, so 78.6 is likely the low end of the spread.

warnings.memHigh: mem-fraction 0.90: two machines — this project's and the toolkit's — recorded unrecoverable wedges during weight load at higher fractions (GB10 unified memory starves the OS). Use 0.85 unless the box was already known-good at a higher fraction.
warnings.ssmFloat32: float32 SSM state doubles the GDN pool (15.6 → 30.9 GB at pool 80) and leaves only ~12 GB free. bfloat16 is the measured setting; float32 is not measured as a serving config.
warnings.specOff: Speculative decoding off: this recipe was measured with DFlash2 on, and the draft is the largest single-stream lever (+28% at draft 16). Expect target-only decode speed — numbers here are not from this repo's measurements.
warnings.offline: First start still touches the network even with a warm cache: SGLang's early speculative probe resolves the draft config without a revision, so a cache holding only the pinned snapshot can still fetch that repo's default ref. Prime the cache while online.
warnings.htPool: High-throughput pool: 80 slots buys ~11.8 GB of GDN state and ~5% single-stream speed. Revert to the interactive pool if this is a single-user box.

sparkstation.gateway: Gateway on :8000 (LiteLLM); the model container is bridge-networked, its internal :8000 maps to host :8001. Gateway overhead measured at zero.
caveats: The qwen3.8-sglang entry ships pinned to a second machine (host: worker1) — set host: primary.
On current sparkstation main the generic profile no longer lists qwen3.8-sglang (kept for rollback); check the profile you actually use — a profile-level host: wins.
HEALTH_CHECK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=5 × 3 failures restarts a healthy model under long-prefill saturation: raise it to 30.
extra_args.mem_fraction_static needs the sparkstation-mem-fraction-override patch — the stock launcher hard-clamps at 0.82 and ignores anything higher.
uv installs cli.py into site-packages: editing the repo copy does nothing, copy edited modules into .venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/ too.
Never docker rm -f a managed container — the supervisor state goes stale; use sparkstation stop && start.

verify.intro: Everything below reads only environment variables (see .env.example in the repo) — nothing assumes /root or any particular clone location. Run it from wherever the repo lives.
run: python3 bench/perf.py            # TTFT, single-stream, concurrency, prefill
